format_follow.replaces: commute.qwen_anchors.follows_format as used for predictions.json rules.prompt (the format fallback) and for E's format_unprompted reading
format_follow.rule: split the response on '\n'; strip trailing whitespace (Python str.rstrip) from every line; drop lines that are then empty; join with '\n'; the response follows the template if qwen_anchors.FORMAT_RE (unchanged) matches the whole of that text
format_follow.thresholds: unchanged: predictions.json rules.prompt format_with_min 0.9 (with the format system prompt) and format_without_max 0.05 (without), on the 512 search problems, greedy
format_follow.report_beside: the filed regex's count (FORMAT_RE.fullmatch on response.strip()), 17 of 512 with the prompt, in P.json format.with_filed_regex
format_follow.check: stage P re-reads large/P/format.jsonl and large/P/none.jsonl under this rule before anything else; with must be exactly 474/512 = 0.92578125 and without exactly 0 (both counted in advance with an equivalent jq expression, plan appendix A); a miss stops the job (exit 2): the function is not the rule filed here
format_follow.edge_cases: empty or whitespace-only response: miss; CRLF line ends: pass (rstrip removes the carriage return); markdown breaks '  \n' and blank lines anywhere: pass; leading spaces before '- ' or 'Given:': miss (only trailing whitespace is forgiven); 'Steps:' with no dash line: miss; any text after the 'The answer is' line: miss; every response the filed regex accepts is accepted (superset)

anchor1_limits.rule: beside every anchor-1 reading, in every write-up: (i) 'anchor 1 is a format fine-tune: it fixes the novelty of a surface format the model already follows on request, not of a better way to solve problems' (plan section 3); (ii) 'the format prompt lowers W0's GSM8K accuracy on the 512 search problems from 0.834 to 0.680 and shortens answers from 190 to 130 tokens'; (iii) the domain sentence of plan section 1
anchor1_limits.source: results/P.json runs none and format (accuracy); reports/reviews/2026-10-29_review_fable-anchor1-no-prompt.md section 1 (lengths)

decisive_point.anchor2: per seed, the first saved state of a2long at which rules.learned holds (anchor 2: invented exact match >= 0.25 and known >= 0.9 x W0's, from E's generation). Expected and already read: step 100 for both seeds (invented 0.91 and 0.905; known 1.0 and 0.99 against W0's 0.97). A seed with no learned saved state: that seed is missing (single-seed, no row validated)
decisive_point.target_source: mean of a2long_s0 and a2long_s1 KL to start on all 128 maths rows at step 100: 0.6289733393862986 and 0.6073962852498345 (results/E_a2long_s{0,1}.json states.100.kl.maths); a fixed number from here on, not recomputed
decisive_point.rule: every run (gold_s0, own_s0 or own2_s0, null_s0, a1_s0, a1_s1, and a2long_s0/_s1 themselves) is read at its saved state with the smallest |log(KL_maths / target)|, KL_maths the 128-row maths KL from E's states (a tie takes the later step; states with KL 0, non-finite or missing are never chosen). Matched if r9(|log(KL_maths / target)|) <= r9(log(tol_ratio)). The matched KL and the arm's |dW| (Frobenius over the 196 matrices) are stated beside every reading
decisive_point.tol_source: reports/reviews/2026-10-29_review_fable-anchor2-grid.md option (d) ('say a factor 1.5'); for scale: the grid's own spacing is a factor of about 3, and the two anchor-2 seeds differ by |log| 0.035
decisive_point.extra_save: own, own2, null and a1 add target_kl_maths to their save grid (stage T: the first read at or past it on either axis saves dW there and at the read before, as for the grid values), so a state near the target exists if the arm passes it before step 100. gold_s0 is not rerun: its step 100 (0.6966, |log| 0.119) is in the band
decisive_point.learned: the chosen state must be learned under rules.learned (below). Anchor 1 seed not learned there, or unmatched: that seed is missing, so no row is validated and a card goes to the user. A GSM8K arm (own, gold) or the null not learned there, or unmatched: not read on the decisive rows; its readings at the chosen state are reported as unmatched observations
decisive_point.reading: unchanged otherwise: the decomposition rows (predictions.json rules.decomposition_rows) are read on each run's own rows at its chosen state; validation and the t-reading as filed. Every maths-row reading of anchor 2 carries 'anchor 2's movement on the maths rows is mostly a format shift (one-line answers), not its content' (results/check_format.json: with a 4-shot prompt its GSM8K accuracy at step 100 is within 0.016 of W0's)
